outcome.technical:
CHANGES. plugins/audit/scripts/governance/drive-phase.py remove_task_tree: when read_provenance answers not-ours, the refusal now names the task the marker records ahead of the clipped basis - 'its marker names P1.9, not P1.1 (<basis clipped to 200 bytes>)' - and keeps the old 'its marker does not name P1.1 (...)' wording when the record names no task or names this one (no marker file, unreadable marker, foreign createdBy). The comment says why: the basis opens with the marker's absolute path, so its clip cuts off the name under a long temp or project path. This is the previous executor's proposed patch, judged sound and applied as-is apart from the comment wording. tests/test_drive_phase.py ta9: the predicate went from `"P1.9" in d` to `"its marker names P1.9, not P1.1 (" in d`, with a comment, so the case now fails on the wording at any TMPDIR length instead of only under a long one. A deeper fixture prefix was rejected because it pushes Windows fixture paths past MAX_PATH. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: one sentence in the 'One remover' paragraph names this and cites ta9.

ACCEPTANCE 1 (ta9 under a long TMPDIR, a scratch dir with two extra components of 52 and 51 characters): before the fix, `tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest --stage ta-block` gave exit 1, 'SELFTEST FAILED: 27/28', and ta9 FAIL with the did-line cut inside the temp path. After the fix: exit 0, 'ALL PASS: 28/28', and the did-line reads 'its marker names P1.9, not P1.1 (...'.

ACCEPTANCE 2 (the helper's verdict at the fixed head): NOT SHOWN. The helper's baseline is HEAD's code, and this tree's HEAD is the unfixed base fbd3e2d7, so its run here reports HEAD's own tests NOT green. The verdict line is quoted in redFirst.basis ('...HEAD's own tests on HEAD's code are not green (SELFTEST FAILED: 792/793 cases passed)', only ta9 failing). Showing HEAD green needs a commit carrying the fix, and I may not commit. The orchestrator owes this after the commit: from the project, `python3 <driver>/stamp-verification.py red --project <project> --manifest docs/audit/audit-plan.json --task P155.16-gfj --json --derive-introduces -- python3 tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest`, expecting the basis to say HEAD's own tests are green (that run itself then ends could-not-prove or 'no red', since a fixed HEAD has no red to show). The nearest evidence I could gather: the whole drive suite under the same long TMPDIR on scratch exports gave 709/763 with HEAD's drive-phase.py and 710/763 with the fixed one. Diffing the two sorted FAIL-id lists leaves exactly one line, 'FAIL ta9'.

A FINDING OUTSIDE THIS TASK, same class, not fixed. Under that deep TMPDIR, ws-block, pv-block, pv4-block and rw-block raise while building their cases, and the rv/wf/xs/wl/wk/wi/wj cases fail. That happens identically on HEAD's code (ws-block alone: 0/2 RAISED 'ValueError: no path specified' on both copies; 18/18 on both under an ordinary TMPDIR). The cause visible at test_drive_phase.py ws10's line: `--record` cannot be read off the writer dispatch line, which looks like a byte-bounded print losing a field to a long path. The helper's real throwaway does not reach that depth (only ta9 failed there), so this does not block the helper today. It is worth a register entry: a long project or temp path drops a field from a bounded drive line.
